title: Moon Mahadasha || Dasha Of Peace and Happiness || Everything You Need To Know About It
description:
Chandrama is responsible for the types of thoughts you have in your life and how you are doing to process things in life as they happen. Moon rules over your emotions and food habits as well - when you improve your Food your thoughts and actions will start changing for better. If you consume foods  which increase Pitt energy , your anger will start increasing very soon. Different Planets will cause the thought process of your mind to change - Moon with Ketu one will always follow intuition and make very erratic decisions and in spite of being very intelligent , others will not be able to understand such a person. 
Moon being well placed will remove fear from one's life and make sure that one is able to enjoy wealth whereas when Moon is afflicted there is always a tension which the native is unable to express to others. 
Dasha of Moon will change your home because this is the time where your food and water has to change. If Moon is well placed such as in 2nd house or 4th house you will be able to go to a very peaceful and positive area where you will stay. As different Antar Dashas comes within the Mahadasha of Moon - the results will change such as Moon-Ketu dasha will make sure that you stop speaking with the society and go into a mode of self introspection for your own growth whereas Moon Rahu Dasha will make you Hoard things Non-Stop. You need to see how your Moon is placed and if its afflicted, take advise of someone else before making any big decisions.
